wholesale.label: REAL: CAISO OASIS day-ahead LMP, DLAP_SCE-APND; per-day best schedule for one Base Core at each floor

homes.label: ASSUMED (the pilot: our 160 free Base Core batteries plus 29 home-owned)

homeOwned.label: ASSUMED (modelled at Base Core spec, as in the pilot app)

medicalHomes.label: ASSUMED (the pilot: free batteries go to Medical Baseline homes first)

branchHomes.label: REAL (SCE PSPS record: RAR8848 cut 456 customers)

homeKWhPerDay.label: REAL (SCE usage by ZIP: Malibu 90265 averaged about 32 kWh a day in Oct 2025)

touPeak.label: ASSUMED (SCE TOU-D-4-9PM on-peak 4-9 PM, about $0.60 in 2025, as in the pilot)

eventPay.label: REAL rate (CPUC ELRP pays $2/kWh exported); the event itself is SIMULATED

circuitLabels.loads: REAL shape (SCE open data, Cuthbert hourly October 2024 min and max), scaled to the branch
circuitLabels.units: INFERENCE: values treated as amps per phase; MW = sqrt(3) x kV x A / 1000 (27.7 kW per unit at 16 kV)
circuitLabels.scaling: ASSUMED: branch load = Cuthbert x 456 / 2,407 (every customer draws alike), as in the pilot
circuitLabels.ordinary: ASSUMED: an ordinary evening sits at the midpoint of each hour's October min and max
circuitLabels.importLimitMW: ASSUMED: the branch's October peak, 0.97 MW, the cap the pilot uses
circuitLabels.exportCapMW: ASSUMED: reverse flow up to 15% of the import limit, as in the pilot

scenario.title: Price-feed glitch
scenario.story: A bad price tick makes our optimizer order all 189 batteries to charge at full power, 3.8 MW on a branch that peaks under 1 MW.

scenario.title: Stolen key
scenario.story: Someone signs a fleet-wide full discharge with a key that is not on the trust list, posing as SCE, the day before the shutoff.

scenario.title: Replay
scenario.story: A captured 7 AM SCE test order is re-sent, with its old epoch and valid signature.

scenario.title: Bad forecast
scenario.story: A broken forecast tells our optimizer to drain every battery to 5% by 9 PM, the night before the power goes off.

scenario.title: SCE opens RAR8848
scenario.story: SCE opens switch RAR8848 for 45 minutes of switching ahead of tomorrow's shutoff; the 456 homes behind it island.

scenario.title: Market export on a dead line
scenario.story: A market award asks the branch to export 10 kW per home while RAR8848 is open.

scenario.title: SCE flex event
scenario.story: Valid, signed, priority 0: export 3 kW per home from 6 to 8 PM. No emergency was called that evening; this one is simulated.

scenario.title: Cell tower drops
scenario.story: The cell tower serving most of the branch goes down; about 80 batteries go quiet at once.

scenario.title: Stuck-SOC bug
scenario.story: Most v2.3 units on the branch keep reporting the same SOC while they export.

scenario.title: BMS fault
scenario.story: One battery behind RAR8848 reports a BMS fault and goes silent.

scenario.title: Rebound after the event
scenario.story: Right after the event our optimizer orders every battery to recharge at full power, 3.8 MW on the branch.

sce.label: SCE default
sce.description: Default pack for an SCE-territory fleet: 20% backup floor (50% for medical homes), 90 s heartbeat, 15 min command age limit, canary for big orders.

installation.label: Installation (strict)
installation.description: Strict military-installation pack: only the utility and the on-site energy manager may command batteries; vendor and market clouds are held; every fleet-wide order goes to a person; 40% floor.

australia.label: Australia DOE (illustrative)
australia.description: Illustrative dynamic-operating-envelope pack: each circuit import/export limit is recomputed every 5 minutes; tighter export at midday (solar), wider in the evening.
